markers.name: Spencer St / Bourke St
markers.description: Dome camera at the Spencer St / Bourke St intersection monitoring pedestrian and vehicle movement on both streets. Housing consistent with PTZ models though not confirmed on site. Likely part of Melbourne SafeCity network with Victoria Police access.

markers.name: Spencer St / Bourke St (Station Side)
markers.description: Continuous timestamped footage of pedestrians and vehicles. Stored centrally, accessible to Victoria Police under data sharing arrangements. Retention period not publicly disclosed.

markers.name: Spencer St / Bourke St (Spencer Outlet Centre)
markers.description: Dome camera monitoring pedestrian movement beneath the Spencer St overpass. Operator unclear — could be City of Melbourne SafeCity, VicRoads, or private building management.

markers.name: Southern Cross Station (KFC)
markers.description: Continuous video footage capturing passenger presence, movement and physical appearance. Timestamped and linked to station location. Footage accessible to Metro Trains security staff and Victoria Police. Retention period not publicly disclosed.

markers.name: Swanston Street / Bourke Street (Station Side)
markers.description: Counts pedestrian volumes by time and direction. Aggregate data published on data.melbourne.vic.gov.au, but individual-level retention is not disclosed. No signage identifying its presence.

markers.name: Spencer St / Bourke St Tram Stop
markers.description: Tram stop Myki reader recording card ID and tap-on timestamp. On trams tap-off is optional, so destination is inferred rather than directly recorded. Bank card and phone tap-on also accepted, linking travel directly to financial identity.

markers.name: Swanston St / Little Lonsdale St (QV entrance)
markers.operator: likely City of Melbourne or building security
